## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      6 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 27.06.2026 - 18.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _anthonyb176_, 18.09.2026, 1/5: "The app doesn’t always track steps, distance, or workouts accurately. If I end a workout at 9800 steps and then walk 200 steps, the app still says I only walked 9800 steps. A lot of the workouts that should be standard are also locked unless you buy additional hardware. 9/18/26 Sharing fitness data with other contacts doesn’t work. My wife and I can’t share with each other our any of our friends from either of our devices or accounts. It just says “There was an error sending your activity sharing invitation. Try sending it again.” This has been an issue for the past 6 months, at least."
            2. _Vanessalikescake_, 13.09.2026, 1/5: "Every time I do a workout it freezes and goes on a loop without finishing the workout routine. It’s frustrating and causing me to waste a lot of time."
            3. _Beef_Curtains_, 13.09.2026, 1/5: "When i synced it to my google health app it doubled all my steps and there was no fixing it. I tried for hours but its broken. Feels like i lost all my hard-work and data because of a dumb technical glitch."
